plumbing.name: 2022 CSBC Plumbing (2021 IPC; residential plumbing from IRC P chapters per state)

elsewhere: 2026 Connecticut State Building Code (2024 I-codes, 2023 NEC) was expected 2026-07-01 but is delayed pending Legislative Regulation Review Committee approval (still pending as of Aug 2026), so the 2022 CSBC governs in Oct 2026.
notes: Statewide and mandatory. CT frost depth 42 in is a commonly used local value but not in the retrieved sources.
